newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-HITZFELD QUITS NINE DAYS AFTER EURO TRIUMPH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HITZFELD QUITS NINE DAYS AFTER EURO TRIUMPH.

text.p: Ottmar Hitzfeld has quit as coach of European Cup winners Borussia Dortmund just nine days after the biggest triumph in the club's history.
Hitzfeld told a news conference on Friday he would be taking over as sports director at the club. It is not yet known who will take his place as trainer.

Hitzfeld has been in charge since 1991 and last week led Dortmund to the biggest moment in their history with a 3-1 victory over Juventus in the European Cup final in Munich. He also steered the club to German league titles in 1995 and 1996.
Earlier this week Hitzfeld hinted at management problems at the club after long-serving chairman Gerd Niebaum announced he was stepping down.
In a newspaper interview Hitzfeld said he was disappointed by Niebaum's failure to back efforts to resolve long-standing morale problems at the club.
But while Hitzfeld has acknowledged that relations between himself and his team have not been perfect, his decision to step down has come as a surprise.
